subTitle: Is your boat not starting? Here are some self help tips while you wait:

items.text: Ensure your safety lanyard is properly attached.
Verify that your throttle is in the neutral position.
Check your battery cables to make sure they are connected properly and the battery switch is turned to the on position.
Verify the fuel and oil levels of your vessel are adequate.
Keep an eye on your ski rope to ensure it is not entangled in your propellor.
Drop your anchor if possible to make sure you will not float into the shoreline/rocks.
If this is a life threatening or medical emergency, please call 911.
The U.S. Coast Guard can be contacted on VHF Channel 16.
